content.text: No non-solicitation, no-hire, or employee-poaching restriction appears anywhere in the agreement.

input.quote: (c) The relationship of the Parties is that of independent contractors, and nothing herein is intended, nor should be construed, to create a partnership, agency, joint venture or employment relationship.
input.rationale: Searches for "solicit", "recruit", "induce", "hire", "employ" and "personnel" across the single-section agreement return no restrictive covenant on hiring or soliciting either Party's employees. The only personnel-related provisions are the independent-contractor clause (p0066), the confidentiality provisions limiting internal disclosure to employees who need it (p0061), and indemnity references to persons "hired by, employed, retained" by a Party (p0051, p0052) — none of which restrain Customer from soliciting or employing Kubient personnel. The survival list in p0070 likewise contains no non-solicit. This matches our preferred position of no non-solicit binding the Customer, so no redline is required.
